import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

def task_func(df, x_column, y_column):
    if x_column not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"Column '{x_column}' not found in DataFrame.")
    if y_column not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"Column '{y_column}' not found in DataFrame.")

    data = df.loc[:, [x_column, y_column]].dropna()
    if len(data) < 2:
        raise ValueError("At least 2 valid rows are required to fit a linear regression model.")

    try:
        data = data.astype(float)
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as e:
        raise ValueError("Specified columns must contain numeric data that can be converted to float.") from e

    X = data[[x_column]].values
    y = data[y_column].values

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.scatter(data[x_column], data[y_column])

    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X, y)

    x_sorted = sorted(data[x_column].tolist())
    x_line = [[x] for x in x_sorted]
    y_line = model.predict(x_line)

    ax.plot(x_sorted, y_line, color="red")
    return ax
